$comment: Committed baseline for the scored Staff Assistant eval gate.
lib/ai/eval/staff-scenarios.ts, deterministically: no model, no network, no database.
The gate (tests/unit/ai/staff-eval-gate.test.ts) fails when a dimension falls below
value - tolerance. Tolerance 0 marks a security-relevant dimension where any
regression is a defect rather than a quality dip; 0.05 marks a quality dimension
where one scenario of movement in a 20-30 scenario corpus is not yet a signal.
Update this file only with a measured run and a stated reason.

priorRun.$comment: The same corpus scored against the pre-change tree (staff_clinical_summary.maxSteps = 8, no cross-turn tool memory, no staff repair).
